actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: A productive bicycle workshop shares air and river space with residents: visible plume and discharge illustrate environmental effects beside useful output. No emission quantity, toxicity diagnosis or universal market-economy claim is invented.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px workshop, chimney plume, river discharge and observing residents remain visible; tiny fish and advertising text are optional decoration.
actualInspection.desktop: 680 px keeps the workshop/river/person relationship and environmental heading clear; smoke/pipe establish the environmental question.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Resident points toward the river in their own line of sight. Factory signs face viewers/customers, no backward worksheet or measurement display.
actualInspection.style: Friendly approachable comic raster, clear broad colors, large conceptual objects; no photorealistic or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: River is drawn clear and lively; this is a conceptual question about effects, not a factual depiction establishing contaminated water or quantified damage. A pollution-detection task must use separate supplied evidence.
